metadata.description: Heuremen LLC plugins: check published claims against our Standards, gate readings with a check block, and check IBM Quantum calibration records before and after a run.

plugins.name: standards
plugins.description: Check a paper or claim against the Standards claim codes and return a recount card with quotes, scope and four-state statuses.

plugins.name: readcheck
plugins.description: Refuse a git commit that adds a reading (results, outcomes) without a complete check block keyed to the Standards recount requirements.

plugins.name: qia-calibration
plugins.description: Check the IBM Quantum calibration record a run depends on, before the run and after it. Read-only, standard library only.
